provenance.provenance_evidence: The project-owned projection passage reproduces the retained calendar body hash exactly. Its artifact manifest records the bounded public-domain 1862 Pustet antecedent, the separate 1962 target, and every editorial transformation; neither witness is represented as owning the projected bytes. The 1962 reading was established on that edition's page images rather than its text layer, cross-read against the Benziger conformed printing. Differences from the antecedent: antecedent witness is the Mame, Tours 1922 (editio quarta iuxta typicam Vaticanam); 100% of the 1962 body's tokens align in order after canon folding; the Mame prints j where the 1962 prints i (Iesum/Jesum, eius/ejus) and its recogniser renders the ae ligature as 'z' or 'e'; both are orthographic; pointing: the antecedent's reading is recorded verbatim above so its commas and colons can be compared, but its punctuation is NOT safely collatable - the recogniser turns commas into full stops, semicolons and question marks - so no punctuation difference here should be read as a difference between the printings; the 1962 prints the conclusion as 'Per Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum, Filium tuum: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate.'; conclusion length was excluded from the alignment and is recorded here as printed, per the settled rule. Corroboration: Pustet 1862 text-layer lines 74858-74863 (76% coverage); Vatican typical 1604 at line 44800 (47%; degraded, corroboration only); Benziger 1962 conformed printing at line 71396 (65%; comparison only, never a publication basis).

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Beati Apostoli et Evangelistae Matthaei, Domine, precibus adjuvemur: ut,
quod possibilitas nostra non obtinet, ejus nobis intercessione donetur. Per
Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum, Filium tuum: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in
unitate.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Supplicationibus beati Matthaei Apostoli et Evangelistae, quaesumus, Domine,
Ecclesiae tuae commendetur oblatio: cujus magnificis praedicationibus
eruditur. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum, Filium tuum: Qui tecum vivit
et regnat in unitate.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Perceptis, Domine, sacramentis, beato Matthaeo Apostolo tuo et Evangelista
interveniente, deprecamur: ut, quae pro ejus celebrata sunt gloria, nobis
proficiant ad medelam. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum, Filium tuum: Qui
tecum vivit et regnat in unitate.
